subject: [gud] T1: Build the Acme Notes marketing website
body:
Turn this repo into a small marketing website for Acme Notes, a note-taking app.

- index.html: a landing page with a hero, three feature cards, and a call to action linking to pricing.html.
- pricing.html: three plans (Free, Pro $8/mo, Team $15/user/mo) in a comparison table.
- about.html: a short company story and a contact email link (mailto:hello@acme.example).
- styles.css: shared styles for the nav, hero, cards, and pricing table; a responsive layout under 700px.

Every page must keep <!doctype html>, a <title>, link styles.css, and share the same <nav> that links
index.html, pricing.html, and about.html. Keep `python -m pytest -q` passing, and add tests under tests/
that check the pages.

+

About Acme

Acme started in 2020 with a simple idea: taking notes should be fast, calm and everywhere you are. Today a small, remote team builds Acme Notes for thousands of writers, students and teams.

Questions? hello@acme.example

+ + diff --git a/tests/test_pages.py b/tests/test_pages.py --- /dev/null +++ b/tests/test_pages.py @@ -0,0 +1,50 @@ +import re +from pathlib import Path + +ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent +PAGES = ["index.html", "pricing.html", "about.html"] + + +def read(name): + return (ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8") + + +def nav(name): + m = re.search(r"", read(name), re.S | re.I) + assert m, name + return m.group(0) + + +def test_pages_basics(): + for p in PAGES: + html = read(p) + assert html.lstrip().lower().startswith("") + assert "" in html.lower() + assert "styles.css" in html + for target in PAGES: + assert target in nav(p) + + +def test_nav_shared(): + navs = {re.sub(r"\s+", " ", nav(p)) for p in PAGES} + assert len(navs) == 1 + + +def test_index_links_pricing(): + assert 'href="pricing.html"' in read("index.html").split("</nav>")[1] + + +def test_pricing_plans(): + html = read("pricing.html") + assert "<table" in html + for s in ["Free", "Pro", "Team", "$8/mo", "$15/user/mo"]: + assert s in html + + +def test_about_mailto(): + assert "mailto:hello@acme.example" in read("about.html") + + +def test_css_responsive(): + css = read("styles.css") + assert "700px" in css and "@media" in css ```
